# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Use precise measurement techniques.
3. Verify and calibrate monitoring equipment regularly.
4. Measure and document the type, concentration, and duration of emissions.
5. Compare emissions data with regulatory standards.
6. Document weather conditions during the monitoring period.
7. Use site-specific information and maps.
8. Provide detailed descriptions of industrial processes and equipment.
9. Include data from continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS), if available.
10. Document any exceedances of permissible emission limits.
11. Verify the data with other sources like dispersion modeling, air quality sensors, or remote sensing.
12. Obtain third-party validation if possible.
13. Include dates and times of observations.
14. Document procedures for determining stack height, temperature, velocity, and opacity.
15. Attach supporting photos or videos, if available.
16. Mention the method of sampling and analysis.
17. Document any unusual occurrences, maintenance activities, or operational changes during the monitoring period.
18. Keep
